story: The 2018 Camp Fire re-runs from Pulga; the slider buys fuel breaks that stall it short of town.

data.fuel: MOCK — fake data for frontend dev

simplifications: MOCK DATA — every number on this screen is fake; web/data/ replaces it
Fire spread is minimum travel time over a grid, not full Rothermel physics
Wind is one constant speed and direction for the whole 12 hours
Buildings are points; 'saved' means fire never arrives within 12 hours
Fuel breaks slow the fire 20x; they don't stop embers
